HOME.BUS_DESC: For large groups, our bus is the perfect choice. With capacity for up to 40 people, it offers comfort, safety, and space for everyone to enjoy the trip.

FOOTER.ABOUT_TEXT: For over 10 years, E&J Tour has turned tours into unforgettable experiences in Foz do Iguaçu. Our commitment is to guarantee comfort, safety, and the best experience for every visitor. With experienced guides and personalized itineraries, we take you to the main tourist spots, such as the Iguazu Falls, the Itaipu Dam, and the Triple Frontier. Travel with us and discover Foz do Iguaçu in a unique way!

AQUAFOZ.TITLE: AquaFoz - Foz do Iguaçu Aquarium
AQUAFOZ.DESC: Explore the largest aquarium in the region with over 300 freshwater and saltwater species in 3.3 million liters. A journey from the Iguaçu and Paraná rivers to the oceans, featuring an underwater tunnel and unforgettable immersive experiences.

CATARATAS_BR.TITLE: Iguazu Falls - Brazilian Side
CATARATAS_BR.DESC: Explore the impressive waterfalls of Iguazu from the Brazilian side, with panoramic views and trails that provide an unforgettable experience.

ITAIPU_CIRCUITO.TITLE: Itaipu Circuit
ITAIPU_CIRCUITO.DESC: Explore the Itaipu Dam on a circuit that allows you to see its operations up close and its importance for power generation.

CITY_TOUR_FOZ.TITLE: City Tour Foz do Iguaçu
CITY_TOUR_FOZ.DESC: Meet the main tourist spots of Foz do Iguaçu, including visits to the Buddhist Temple, Omar Ibn Al-Khattab Mosque, and the Three Borders Landmark, exploring the city's cultural and historical diversity.

CITY_TOUR_PY.TITLE: Paraguay City Tour
CITY_TOUR_PY.DESC: Discover a different side of Paraguay, visiting cultural and historical points beyond traditional shopping in Ciudad del Este.

COMPLEXO_DREAMS.TITLE: Dreams Complex
COMPLEXO_DREAMS.DESC: Explore a set of attractions that includes the Wax Museum, Wonders of the World, Dinosaur Valley and Dreams Motor Show, offering interactive and educational experiences for the whole family.

ICE_BAR.TITLE: Dreams Ice Bar
ICE_BAR.DESC: Experience a bar made entirely of ice, with elaborate sculptures and decorations, where you can enjoy drinks served in ice glasses in a freezing and stunning atmosphere.

ITAIPU_ILUMINADA.TITLE: Illuminated Itaipu
ITAIPU_ILUMINADA.DESC: Enjoy a night spectacle where the Itaipu Dam is illuminated with over 747 reflectors and 112 luminaires, creating an impressive visual experience.

ITAIPU_PANORAMICA.TITLE: Panoramic Itaipu
ITAIPU_PANORAMICA.DESC: Discover the grandeur of the Itaipu Dam on a tour offering comprehensive views of the dam, spillway, and Itaipu Lake from strategic observation points.

REFUGIO.TITLE: Itaipu Biological Refuge
REFUGIO.DESC: Explore the richness of local biodiversity on ecological trails passing through preservation areas, learning about environmental conservation projects and diverse plant and animal species.

KATTAMARAM.TITLE: Kattamaram II
KATTAMARAM.DESC: Navigate the waters of the Iguaçu River on a luxurious boat, enjoying panoramic views of the Brazilian, Argentine, and Paraguayan shores, with an optional onboard buffet.

MACUCO.TITLE: Macuco Safari
MACUCO.DESC: Embark on a tour combining a forest trail and boat navigation to the falls of Iguazu, providing an exciting experience close to the waters.

MARAVILHAS.TITLE: Wonders of the World
MARAVILHAS.DESC: Take a trip through the planet's greatest monuments in a theme park featuring detailed replicas of icons like the Eiffel Tower, Christ the Redeemer, and the Statue of Liberty.

MESQUITA.TITLE: Arab Mosque
MESQUITA.DESC: Visit the Omar Ibn Al-Khatab Mosque, a tourist spot highlighting the cultural diversity of Foz do Iguaçu, with impressive architecture and an atmosphere of serenity.

MOTOR_SHOW.TITLE: Motor Show
MOTOR_SHOW.DESC: Enjoy a unique combination of motorcycles, live music, and gastronomy in a themed environment that enchants motorcycle and culture enthusiasts.

MUSEU_CERA.TITLE: Wax Museum
MUSEU_CERA.DESC: Encounter realistic replicas of iconic figures from pop culture, history, and entertainment in interactive settings allowing memorable photos.

NOITE_ARG.TITLE: Argentine Night - Dinner and Show
NOITE_ARG.DESC: Enjoy Argentine culture on a special night with a typical dinner and tango and folklore performances in Puerto Iguazú.

NOITE_CATARATAS.TITLE: Night at the Falls
NOITE_CATARATAS.DESC: Experience a night visit to the Iguazu Falls, contemplating the falls illuminated by the moon and special lights, in a mystical and engaging atmosphere.

PARQUE_AVES.TITLE: Bird Park
PARQUE_AVES.DESC: Visit a conservation sanctuary with over 1,300 birds of 150 different species, walking along trails passing through giant aviaries and interacting with tropical birds in their natural habitat.

POR_SOL_CATARATAS.TITLE: Sunset at the Falls
POR_SOL_CATARATAS.DESC: Experience the magic of the sunset at the Iguazu Falls, when the waters reflect the golden and orange tones of the sun, providing a peaceful and unforgettable experience.

POR_SOL_MARCO.TITLE: Sunset at the Three Borders Landmark
POR_SOL_MARCO.DESC: Enjoy one of the most beautiful sunsets in Foz do Iguaçu, overlooking the Iguaçu and Paraná rivers, while enjoying cultural performances and local gastronomy.

MOVIES_CAR.TITLE: Movies Car
MOVIES_CAR.DESC: Experience the magic of cinema in one of Brazil's largest themed drive-ins! Movies Car offers a unique experience with shows, characters, and unforgettable movies in a Hollywood-inspired setting.

TEMPLO_BUDISTA.TITLE: Buddhist Temple
TEMPLO_BUDISTA.DESC: Visit the Foz do Iguaçu Buddhist Temple, admire the Buddha statues and traditional architecture while learning about Buddhist philosophy in an environment of peace and serenity.

HELICOPTERO.TITLE: Helicopter Flight over the Falls
HELICOPTERO.DESC: Get a unique perspective of the Iguazu Falls on a panoramic helicopter flight, enjoying the waterfalls and surrounding forest from a privileged angle.

WONDER_PARK.TITLE: Wonder Park
WONDER_PARK.DESC: Have fun in a theme park combining attractions like Movie Cars and Water Show, offering entertainment for the whole family.

AVENTURA_CATARATAS.TITLE: Adventure at the Falls
AVENTURA_CATARATAS.DESC: Explore the Iguazu Falls in an exciting way, combining trails, boat rides, and a panoramic flight over the waterfalls.

EXPLORADOR_NATUREZA.TITLE: Nature Explorer
EXPLORADOR_NATUREZA.DESC: Discover the biodiversity of Foz do Iguaçu on a tour combining the region's preserved fauna and flora.

ADRENALINA_TOTAL.TITLE: Total Adrenaline
ADRENALINA_TOTAL.DESC: A package made for adventure lovers, with activities full of emotion and direct contact with nature.

HISTORIA_CULTURA.TITLE: History and Culture of Foz
HISTORIA_CULTURA.DESC: Discover the cultural and religious richness of Foz do Iguaçu by visiting historical temples and monuments.

NOITE_ARGENTINA.TITLE: Argentine Night
NOITE_ARGENTINA.DESC: Enjoy Argentine culture with a themed dinner and a tango and folklore show in Puerto Iguazú.

DESCOBRINDO_ARGENTINA.TITLE: Discovering Argentina
DESCOBRINDO_ARGENTINA.DESC: Explore the charms of the Argentine side of Foz do Iguaçu, including the impressive Argentine Falls, a tour through the historic center of Puerto Iguazú, and a gastronomic experience with typical dishes.

AVENTURAS_PY.TITLE: Adventures in Paraguay
AVENTURAS_PY.DESC: Discover a cultural and natural side of Paraguay that goes beyond shopping, visiting historical monuments, impressive waterfalls, and traditional markets.

TOUR_FRONTEIRAS.TITLE: Three Borders Tour
TOUR_FRONTEIRAS.DESC: Visit the main tourist spots of three countries in a single day, exploring Brazil, Paraguay, and Argentina.

DIVERSAO_FAMILIA.TITLE: Family Fun
DIVERSAO_FAMILIA.DESC: Ideal package for the whole family, combining educational and interactive attractions for children and adults.

ROMANCE_CATARATAS.TITLE: Romance at the Falls
ROMANCE_CATARATAS.DESC: A perfect package for couples who desire special moments in a heavenly setting.
ACTIVITIES: Sunset at the Iguazu National Park

LUA_MEL.TITLE: Honeymoon in Foz
LUA_MEL.DESC: Celebrate love with an exclusive package including unique and unforgettable experiences.
ACTIVITIES: Night tour at the Three Borders Landmark

FOZ_3_DIAS.TITLE: Foz do Iguaçu 3 Days and 2 Nights
FOZ_3_DIAS.DESC: Discover the main tourist spots of Foz do Iguaçu on a 3-day trip.

FOZ_5_DIAS.TITLE: Foz do Iguaçu 5 Days and 4 Nights
FOZ_5_DIAS.DESC: A complete itinerary for those who want to explore Foz do Iguaçu calmly and enjoy all attractions.

ITAIPU.TITLE: Itaipu Hydroelectric Plant
ITAIPU.DESC: Known for its night light shows and the views from the central lookout point.

AQUAFOZ.TITLE: AquaFoz - Foz do Iguaçu Aquarium
AQUAFOZ.DESC: South America's newest aquarium! An immersive journey through 3.3 million liters of water with over 300 species, an underwater tunnel, and giant tanks connecting the Iguaçu and Paraná rivers to the oceans. Conservation, education, and nature all in one place!

CATARATAS.TITLE: Iguazu Falls
CATARATAS.DESC: The Iguazu Falls are a set of waterfalls on the Iguaçu River, located on the border between Brazil and Argentina. They are considered one of the Seven New Wonders of Nature.

MARCO.TITLE: Three Borders Landmark
MARCO.DESC: A unique attraction in the world. Three countries, two rivers, a spectacular view of the borders, rich culture, singular geography between nations, and many stories!
